The Voice Bonnet is a Raspberry-Pi HAT: it has a 40-pin socket, the PocketBeagle 2 does not – connect the pads with jumper wires.
AM6232 · P1 / P2 headers (used pins only)
WM8960 codec - Raspberry Pi HAT, wired by jumpers
privacy switch must be ON - it gates the codec's MCLK oscillator
speakers: JST-PH L/R - headphones: 3.5 mm jack
I2C address 0x24 - shares I2C2 with the codec
usb1 host - music, recordings, tags, config
stick = FAT32, label HAPTIC (plugs into the PB2's usb1 host)
keep D+/D- short and twisted; stick draws up to ~100-500 mA
check P1.03 / P1.05 (DRVVBUS / VBUS) against the PB2 schematic
TP_SDA / TP_SCL: not connected (v1). The CST328 sits at
0x1A like the codec -> needs its own bus (I2C1);
one leg to the pin, other leg to GND
other leg of every button -> GND (P2.15)
other leg -> GND (verify PWR.BTN behaviour on USB-C power)
Where the used pins are on the headers
schematic strips (odd pins top row, even pins bottom row, not to scale) – always check pin 1 / numbering against the board silkscreen
